suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: npx jest reports 4 failing tests out of 97 at the default branch head
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

After `npm install`, `npx jest` runs 97 tests and 4 fail: `Test3MFMaterialImport > testMaterialImport`, `Test3MFRoundTrip > testRoundTripExportImport`, `TestGltfExporter > testSimpleTriangleBinary` and `TestSceneSaveSTL > testRoundtripFile`. Each has a different cause.

## Environment

- Repository: aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
- Revision: `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (the upstream revision this report was verified against, default branch `master`)
- Docker image `node:22` (Node v22.23.3, npm 10.9.9)
- Verified on 2026-10-11 from a fresh shallow clone.

## Steps to reproduce

```
git clone https://github.com/aspose-3d-foss/Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
cd Aspose.3D-FOSS-for-TypeScript
npm install
npx jest
```

## Expected

All tests pass on a clean clone.

## Actual

```
Test Suites: 4 failed, 28 passed, 32 total
Tests:       4 failed, 93 passed, 97 total
```
Failure causes:

- `testMaterialImport`: `ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '../foss.3d.python/examples/3mf/dodeca_chain_loop_color.3mf'`; the fixture lives outside this repository.
- `testRoundTripExportImport`: `TypeError: rotation[0].eulerAngles is not a function` at `Transform.ts:160`.
- `testSimpleTriangleBinary`: `RangeError: The value of "offset" is out of range. It must be >= 0 and <= 636. Received 640` while writing the binary glTF buffer (`writeFloatLE`).
- `testRoundtripFile`: `expect(mesh2.polygonCount).toBe(1)` receives `0` after the STL round trip.

## Where in the repository

- `tests/test_3mf_materials.test.ts`, `tests/test_3mf_roundtrip.test.ts`, `tests/test_gltf_exporter.test.ts`, `tests/test_scene_save_stl.test.ts`
- `src/aspose/threed/Transform.ts:160`

## Suggested fix

Vendor the 3MF fixture into `tests/`, fix or skip the three library failures, and run `npx jest` in CI so a failing test is noticed.
